newsitem.title: USA: Cambridge, Mass. police seek gay, lesbian recruits.
newsitem.headline: Cambridge, Mass. police seek gay, lesbian recruits.

text.p: The Cambridge, Mass., police department issued a statement last week asking gays and lesbians to apply for jobs, the Boston Herald reported Monday.
Homosexuals will not receive any legal preferences in hiring but the police want openly gay people to know they will not be discriminated against, the newspaper said.

"A lot of people feel they aren't welcome in some cities and towns," Cambridge police spokesman Frank Pasquarello told the newspaper. "We are addressing that by making sure members of the gay and lesbian community feel they are welcome."
He said he is not aware of any openly gay officers currently on the force. "We could care less if someone is openly gay, as long as they do their job," he told the Herald.
